_comment: Canonical wallet-address registry for Defenders of the Realm — PUBLIC on-chain addresses ONLY. Extracted VERBATIM from docs/wallets-of-record.md. NO private keys, seed phrases, or signer keypairs are stored here or anywhere in this repo (v2-unity-port-spec.md Part 10). These addresses power the v2 wallet module's transparency display and the devnet pack-purchase smoke test. Devnet-only economy in the v2 Unity foundation.

_sources.portSpec: defenders-unity/docs/v2-unity-port-spec.md (Week 7 — Rewards Distributor display; Part 10 — devnet-only, no secrets)

_schemaNotes.rewardsDistributor: The hardware-backed Seeker Seed Vault wallet that pays SKR rewards to players (Streams A/B/C). PUBLIC, Solscan-lookup-safe. Shown verbatim in the v2 store/settings transparency line — it is NOT a payment recipient. Pack revenue never lands here (wallets-of-record §2).
_schemaNotes.devnetPurchaseRecipient: The devnet pack-purchase test transfers land here in the v2 foundation. wallets-of-record §4 SOL/USDC/SKR revenue-treasury wallets are NOT yet provisioned (blocked on Squads multisig setup), so the documented Dev/Staging wallet (§3 — used for 'pre-mainnet smoke tests verifying pack-purchase flow end-to-end on devnet') is the safe devnet sink until the real treasuries exist. This is a PUBLIC address; no key is held by the game.
_schemaNotes.mainnetGate: When the §4 Squads multisig revenue treasuries are provisioned, the integrator adds them here under a 'mainnetTreasuries' block and the owner flips WalletService.ActiveNetwork to Mainnet. The agent does NOT do this (Part 10).

rewardsDistributor.label: Rewards Distributor
rewardsDistributor.provider: Solana Seeker — Seed Vault (hardware secure element)
rewardsDistributor.purpose: SKR rewards distribution to players (Streams A/B/C).
rewardsDistributor.explorerNote: Public on-chain — Solscan-lookup-safe. Shown for transparency only; never a payment destination.

devnetPurchaseRecipient.label: Devnet Pack-Purchase Recipient (Dev / Staging wallet)
devnetPurchaseRecipient.purpose: Devnet pack-purchase smoke-test recipient. Stands in until the §4 Squads multisig revenue treasuries are provisioned.
devnetPurchaseRecipient.explorerNote: Public on-chain. The v2 foundation routes devnet pack-purchase transfers here. Holds gas-only balances; no production assets.
